entry.summary: Australian citizens don't need a visa or an NZeTA, unless they have a criminal record or have been deported from any country.
entry.pre_arrival: New Zealand Traveller Declaration (NZTD) before passport control, online or by app, free.
entry.other: With any conviction or past deportation, ask a New Zealand Visa Application Centre well before travel. Australian permanent residents need an NZeTA.

laws.rule: Penalties for possessing and using drugs may include fines and prison sentences.
laws.heading: Drugs

laws.rule: You'll need photo ID to buy alcohol or enter licensed premises. You can't use your Australian driver's licence. Approved IDs include: current passport current New Zealand driver's licence
laws.heading: Alcohol laws

laws.rule: New Zealand has strict biosecurity rules. If you don't declare items for quarantine, you'll get an instant fine. If you make a false statement, you'll face heavy fines and prison sentences.
laws.heading: Quarantine regulations

laws.rule: When you arrive, customs officers may check electronic devices they suspect are being used in criminal activity. Devices may include: mobile phones portable tablets hard drives laptops digital cameras
laws.heading: Customs requirements

laws.rule: For specific information on bringing medication into New Zealand, read the New Zealand Customs Service.
laws.heading: Medication

laws.rule: You can drive for up to 12 months with your Australian driver's licence. After that, you'll need to get a local licence.
